title: Boss Challenge: Force Fixers
summary: Eight real problems. Use forces, friction, gravity and pressure to fix each one.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: applying knowledge to unfamiliar situations (Criteria A and D)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 6: Pressure, Winds, Storms and Cyclones

objectives: I can choose the right physics idea (force, friction, gravity or pressure) to explain a real problem.
